native_facts: Dynamic_model_rigid_body computes B(x) plus action_module(action), applies M(q), and optionally adds learned correctors.
ODEBijector calls torchdiffeq.odeint_adjoint with the configured integrator (default dopri5) over one state/action input.
The checked source contains no Lie generators, Magnus expansion, adjoint-representation products, Killing-form constraint, Jacobian determinant monitor, or flow-volume-preservation loss.
The released MoSim checkpoint and model API consume one current action per ODE step; they do not expose a future action sequence or a frequency-domain action carrier.
The existing local probe found identical outputs when an unconsumed future suffix was changed, confirming that future-action anticipation is not a MoSim input path.
rejection_reasons: The proposed mediator and repair are absent from the cited native implementation.
Alternating bounded actions are an ordinary temporal action perturbation and the proposed rank/volume collapse is not distinguished from standard nonlinear sensitivity or integration error.
No local decoder, MPC task gate, or six-seed task-level evidence was supplied; the requested harm outcome is speculative.
The proposal therefore fails the exact carrier audit before any GPU experiment.
